chunks: The answer of the believers when they are called to God and His Apostle that he may judge between them, is: 'We hear and obey.' And they are the ones who will prosper.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific response of the believers when called to divine judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from individual judgment to communal submission under the authority of the Prophet and, by extension, the Imams. The phrase 'We hear and obey' (Sami'na wa ata'na) is often contrasted with the Israelites' 'We will obey and we will be disobedient,' emphasizing a conscious, willing acceptance of divine decree rather than blind compliance. This immediate responsiveness is presented as the definitive marker of the 'successful' (al-muflihun), linking intellectual assent with practical action in the path to salvation.
